narrative.overview:
Notes is a product UI first: a calm, modern workspace that makes daily writing, retrieval, admin, and AI-assisted actions feel dependable. The system uses cool near-black or near-white surfaces, precise blue accents, compact typography, and small-radius controls to support focused work without becoming dry or corporate.

The visual system is premium through restraint: clean tonal layers, sharp icon affordances, custom dropdowns, portal tooltips, controlled animation, and consistent state language. Marketing, public share, pricing, and landing surfaces may carry more emotion and motion, but the authenticated app should keep the task in front.
keyCharacteristics: Cool blue identity with cyan energy, used for state and action.
Flat-by-default surfaces with tonal layering instead of decorative shadow.
Icon-led controls with custom tooltips and accessible labels.
Motion that confirms state, never constant movement.

rules.name: The Blue Earns Attention Rule
rules.body: Blue marks actions, focus, selection, and live state. Do not spend it on decorative filler.

rules.name: The No AI Startup Palette Rule
rules.body: Do not turn violet, magenta, cyan, and glow into a purple-gradient AI brand. Notes must keep its own cool workspace identity.

rules.name: The Product Scale Rule
rules.body: Do not use hero-sized fluid headings inside the app. Product screens use fixed rem sizes so dense layouts remain stable.

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows separate major layout regions only. Component depth should come from color, border, and state.

dos: Do keep working screens calm, compact, and task-focused.
Do use the existing blue/cyan accent vocabulary for action, selection, focus, and status.
Do use custom IconButton, Tooltip, TooltipText, CustomSelect, Modal, and ToastHost patterns instead of native browser UI for product controls.
Do support RU/EN strings by allowing ellipsis, tooltips, and stable control widths.
Do make motion expressive for transitions, loading, success, and state feedback, with prefers-reduced-motion support.
Do keep marketing, landing, pricing, and public conversion pages bolder than the authenticated workspace.
donts: Don't use purple gradient branding, decorative orbs, neon glow, Powered by AI framing, or pseudo-chat as the default screen.
Don't make the product look like a generic 2024 AI/SaaS startup.
Don't use dry corporate admin templates that make the app feel under-designed.
Don't push command-center aesthetics into everyday note work.
Don't use colored border-left or border-right stripes wider than 1px on cards, callouts, or list items.
Don't use native alert, prompt, confirm, native title, or browser selects in the app UI.
Don't let decorative motion run constantly or ignore prefers-reduced-motion.
